questions.q: Alfred Wegener (born 1 Nov 1880) proposed the theory of:
questions.explanation: **Continental drift**. Seafloor spreading came later from Harry Hess.

questions.q: Who named the Pacific Ocean ('Mar Pacifico')?
questions.explanation: **Ferdinand Magellan**.

questions.q: Jogen Chowdhury, who died in 2026, was a noted:
questions.explanation: **Painter**, Padma Bhushan awardee and Rajya Sabha MP (2014-2020).

questions.q: The IUCN moved the snow leopard from Endangered to:
questions.explanation: **Vulnerable** (2017).

questions.q: Which authority made a co-pilot mandatory for helicopters on Uttarakhand's pilgrimage routes?
questions.explanation: The **Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority (UCADA)**.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT an air pollution control device?
questions.explanation: A **catalytic cracker** refines oil. Bag filters, ESPs, cyclone separators and scrubbers capture pollutants.

questions.q: N.R. Madhava Menon, 'father of modern legal education', was the founding director of:
questions.explanation: **National Law School of India University, Bengaluru**.

questions.q: 'Scientific temper' is a Fundamental Duty under:
questions.explanation: **51A(h)**: scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry.

questions.q: Quad Foreign Ministers met in Atlanta (Oct 2026) on the sidelines of:
questions.explanation: The **G20 FMM** in Atlanta (US G20 presidency); $85 million for trusted AI.

questions.q: The Quad (India, US, Japan, Australia) was revived in:
questions.explanation: Revived in **2017**; first leaders' summit in 2021.

questions.q: Indira Gandhi's memorial (samadhi) in Delhi is called:
questions.explanation: **Shakti Sthal**. She was assassinated on 31 Oct 1984.

questions.q: The RSS, now in its centenary year, was founded in 1925 at:
questions.explanation: Founded at **Nagpur** by **K.B. Hedgewar**.

questions.q: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit is which Chief of the Air Staff?
questions.explanation: The **29th**, succeeding A.P. Singh on 31 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Bhutan's Project 108 stupas at Gelephu stand along which river?
questions.explanation: The **Mau Chhu**: 108 chortens, 15 m tall, 108 m apart.

questions.q: Gelephu Mindfulness City (Bhutan) borders which district of Assam?
questions.explanation: **Chirang** district.

questions.q: The Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak was instituted in:
questions.explanation: By an MHA notification of **1 Feb 2024**; 490 personnel received it on 31 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Who is the chairman of ISRO (Nov 2026)?
questions.explanation: **V. Narayanan**.

questions.q: PRAGYA, built by Bengaluru start-up Pranos Fusion, is a:
questions.explanation: A small **tokamak** (fusion device); a bigger one, PRANIK, is planned.

questions.q: India's tokamaks Aditya and SST-1 are at:
questions.explanation: The **Institute for Plasma Research, Gandhinagar**. India is also an ITER member.

questions.q: What share of the divisible pool of central taxes goes to the States?
questions.explanation: **41%**, set by the 15th Finance Commission, released in 14 instalments a year.

questions.q: To allow E100 fuel in flex-fuel vehicles, MoRTH amended the:
questions.explanation: The **Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989** (Rule 115).

questions.q: India hit E20 ethanol blending in 2025. What was the original target year under the National Policy on Biofuels, 2018?
questions.explanation: **2030**; India reached it five years early.

questions.q: Under the IT Rules amended in 2026, platforms must take down unlawful content after a valid order within:
questions.explanation: **3 hours**, down from 36 hours (Rule 3(1)(d)).

questions.q: Which section of the IT Act, 2000 gives intermediaries 'safe harbour'?
questions.explanation: **Section 79**; Section 69A is the Centre's blocking power.

questions.q: NavIC covers India and a region extending about how far beyond its borders?
questions.explanation: About **1,500 km**.

questions.q: Brazilian President Lula da Silva was born in which state?
questions.explanation: **Pernambuco**, on 27 Oct 1945. He won a **fourth** term in 2026.

questions.q: Which country hosts CHOGM 2026?
questions.explanation: **Antigua and Barbuda**. King Charles III heads the Commonwealth.

questions.q: Who is Iran's Supreme Leader (2026)?
questions.explanation: **Mojtaba Khamenei**, since March 2026 after his father Ali Khamenei was killed.

questions.q: The India-Bangladesh Ganges (Farakka) Water Treaty, expiring in Dec 2026, was signed in:
questions.explanation: On **12 Dec 1996**, a 30-year treaty.

questions.q: Who became the fastest to 350 Test wickets by balls bowled (13,808)?
questions.explanation: **Kagiso Rabada**, ahead of Steyn (14,719) and Waqar (14,905).

questions.q: Whose 6/16 at Newlands helped South Africa win the series and top the ICC Test rankings?
questions.explanation: Off-spinner **Simon Harmer**; Jansen was Player of the Series.

questions.q: World champion wrestler Manisha Bhanwala is from which district of Haryana?
questions.explanation: Siwaha village, **Jind**.

questions.q: Who is the defending champion of the WTA 250 Chennai Open?
questions.explanation: **Janice Tjen** of Indonesia.

questions.q: 'Mawal', used to colour Kashmiri wazwan dishes, is made from:
questions.explanation: Dried **cockscomb** (*Celosia cristata*) petals.

questions.q: Which State was NOT formed on 1 November?
questions.explanation: **Jharkhand** was formed on 15 Nov 2000.

questions.q: Haryana marked 60 years in 2026. It was formed in:
Who is the Chief Minister of Keralam (Nov 2026)?
questions.explanation: **V.D. Satheesan**.

questions.q: The Mahtari Vandan Yojana for women belongs to which State?
questions.explanation: **Chhattisgarh**: ₹20,708 crore paid to 68 lakh women.

questions.q: Who chairs SEBI (Nov 2026)?
questions.explanation: **Tuhin Kanta Pandey**.

questions.q: Who is the UK Prime Minister (Nov 2026)?
questions.explanation: **Andy Burnham**.

questions.q: Under Article 324(5), the Chief Election Commissioner can be removed:
options: By a simple majority of Lok Sabha
By the President on the PM's advice
Only like a Supreme Court judge
questions.explanation: Only in the manner of an **SC judge** (proved misbehaviour or incapacity).

questions.q: Inter-State river water disputes are dealt with under:
questions.explanation: **Article 262**; e.g. the Cauvery Tribunal (award 2007).

questions.q: Finance Commissions are set up under:
questions.explanation: **Article 280**. The 16th FC is chaired by Arvind Panagariya.

questions.q: In Shreya Singhal v Union of India (2015), the Supreme Court struck down:
questions.explanation: **Section 66A**; it upheld 69A.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The NDPS Act is India's main anti-drug law.
Reason (R): The Narcotics Control Bureau was created under it in 1986.
options: Both A and R are true, and R explains A
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
questions.explanation: Both are true (NDPS Act **1985**, NCB **1986**), but the NCB's creation does not explain why the Act is the main law.
